The Studio

About Echolume

Echolume is a graphic design studio dedicated to bringing music, film, and fashion stories to life through bold, emotionally-driven visuals.

Founded by Antonio, a multidisciplinary creative with a passion for storytelling, Echolume exists to amplify voices that deserve to be seen and heard.

From motion posters and album covers to full-scale branding campaigns, Echolume blends art direction, design, and cultural awareness to create work that resonates. Our mission is simple: to translate your vision into iconic imagery that connects with audiences and leaves a lasting impact.
